description: This file defines the class CollectEffectedSubjectsVisitor, a visitor implementation for traversing policy tree nodes to determine affected subjects based on permissions, resource nodes, and their relationships within a policy enforcement context.

classes.name: CollectEffectedSubjectsVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class for traversing policy tree nodes to collect subjects affected by specific permissions, considering resource and subject nodes within the policy tree.

methods.name: CollectEffectedSubjectsVisitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the visitor with a resource pointer and expected permissions.

methods.name: visitTreeNode
methods.description: Handles visiting a policy tree node, dispatching to subject or resource node handling.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the accumulated EffectedSubjects after traversal.

methods.name: visitSubjectNode
methods.description: Handles visitation logic when a subject node is encountered.

methods.name: visitResourceNode
methods.description: Handles visitation logic when a resource node is encountered.
